sources.files: Every sound file is mono, true peak at most -1 dBTP; credits in the wiki's Sound-Credits page. Ambience (beds, surf, lapping, slosh, leak, slaps, whitecaps) is mastered to -26 LUFS integrated. Events the player must hear (a knock, a crack, a break-up, snapping lashings, a breaker's slam, water over the gunwale) are mastered to -18 LUFS with a limiter, since a volume can't exceed 1.
sources.levels: Volumes set against vanilla by calculation from its code: in the game a sound plays at its file's loudness + 20 log10(volume x the player's setting for its type x distance attenuation). Distance attenuation is OpenAL exponent-clamped with reference max(3, sqrt(range) - 2) and rolloff ln 100 / ln range; weather and our beds play relative to the listener, unattenuated. Vanilla at sea: wind -39 LUFS just audible, -31 at wind speed 0.7, -24 in a full gale; rain -33 moderate, -27 heavy; raft idle -50; shore lapping -51 beside 100 edge blocks.
sources.beds: By the wind speed at the listener in m/s, not the wave height: a young sea in a gale already roars. lufs is the sea's level in the game, -46 + 30 log10(wind / 2 m/s): -46 at 2 m/s, -34 at 5, -20 at 15 (past vanilla's full wind at -24), -12 at force 10, -7 at 40 m/s; each loop's lufs is its file's measured loudness, mastered toward -8. A storm deafens: events stay at their own level (a hard knock -18) and drown in it from about force 8.
sources.shore: Block ambient, volume clamp(sqrt(blocks) / surfBlockCount) x strength. Surf -44 LUFS beside a gentle shore, -35 beside 400 breaking blocks in a 1.5 m sea, -28 on a storm coast. Lapping replaces vanilla's waterwaves (-36.75 LUFS) with a -26 LUFS file at 0.29 x the strength vanilla's would need.
sources.hull: At a rider 1.5 m away: slap -40 to -32, full bilge slosh -34, leak trickle at most -40, hull lapping -44. The whitecap hiss -37 LUFS at 12 m, under a force-6 wind.
sources.events: An event plays at least 6 dB over the loudest background of the moment, the full gale's wind at -24 LUFS: a hard knock, a crack, a break-up and a slam at -18, a light knock at -24, water over the gunwale -26 to -19. The reed boat's soft crunches only reach -24 under the limiter.
sources.vanillaRowing: Scales vanilla's own rowing sound (raft-moving, -26 LUFS at full speed, unpositioned) to -40, under our beds, keeping it as the sound of the oars.
